heroDamage.description: Damage each correct spell does to the warlord (100 HP): 4 = 25 spells to win, 10 = 10, 25 = 4. Lower values make the duel longer and harder. Applies to the next spell that lands.

enemyDamage.description: Damage each enemy strike does to the hero (100 HP): 15 = 7 strikes to lose, 8 = 13, 25 = 4. Higher values punish slow typing harder. Applies to the next strike.

enemyAttackRateMs.description: Milliseconds between enemy strikes. Lower values add time pressure. In a duel the attack timer restarts with the new period at once.

healAmount.description: HP restored when the player casts a 'heal' word (1 in 11 words, 1 in 7 sentences). 0 turns healing off. Applies to the next heal.

showHelper.description: 1 shows the translation to type under each prompt (a copy-typing task); 0 hides it, so the player must recall the translation (vocabulary recall). Applies to the word on screen at once.

useSentences.description: 1 asks for whole short sentences instead of single words (about 3 times as many letters per spell); 0 single words. Applies from the next word.
